def analyze(key):
    gi,go=G[key+' input'],G[key+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    r0=min(i for i in range(H) if 2 in gi[i]); r1=max(i for i in range(H) if 2 in gi[i])
    c0=min(j for j in range(W) if any(r[j]==2 for r in gi)); c1=max(j for j in range(W) if any(r[j]==2 for r in gi))
    dots=[(i,j,gi[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j] not in (0,2)]
    ud=[d for d in dots if d[0]<r0]; ld=[d for d in dots if d[0]>r1]
    md=[d for d in dots if r0<=d[0]<=r1]
    print(key,'block rows',r0,r1,'cols',c0,c1)
    print(' upper dots:',[(d[1],d[2]) for d in ud])
    print(' lower dots:',[(d[1],d[2]) for d in ld])
    print(' mid dots:',[(d[1],d[2]) for d in md])
    ustrip={j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if go[0][j]==2 and gi[0][j]==0}
    lstrip={j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if go[H-1][j]==2 and gi[H-1][j]==0}
    midfill=all(go[i][j]==2 for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==0 and r0<=i<=r1) or True
    print(' upper stripes(block span):',sorted(ustrip))
    print(' lower stripes(block span):',sorted(lstrip))
    return r0,r1,c0,c1,ud,ld,md
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    analyze(k)
